verdict.rationale: Square's own marketing pages say it uses machine learning to spot and block payment fraud, and that sellers can set custom rules and alerts to manage risk. That covers the core of the story at the product level, but only through marketing-level claims. missing for 10: evidence of exposed per-transaction ML fraud scores, documented block/review/allow rule actions, rule-authoring docs or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules

citations.quote: Square uses sophisticated machine learning to spot and block payment fraud at no extra cost.
Get insights into payment fraud patterns, and set custom rules and alerts to manage risk.
